headline: A 2022 law renames a Houston post office building after Benny C. Martinez.
what_it_does: This act names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 4020 Broadway Street in Houston, Texas, the Benny C. Martinez Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff. It is an honorary designation.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 27, 2022.
